notes:
Lead: CTO Markus Vogel (legal heavy). Use-case: EU-only doc search + compliance audit trails for regulated payments product. Key constraint: must guarantee that model inference and all logs are stored and processed in EU (preference: Germany). Procurement/Legal will not sign if any token-level data crosses non-EU regions or if backups replicate to US. Quote from compliance: 'No data may leave the EU perimeter under any circumstances.'

Timeline (high level):
- 2025-10-01: Inbound via webinar form; initial discovery with AE (Ava).
- 2025-11-12: Intro demo + architecture call (ff_20251112_cedarbridge_intro). Good engagement; product fit looks strong for doc-search + compliance monitoring.
- 2025-12-05: Security deep-dive with SE (Liam) and legal (ff_20251205_security_walkthrough). Customer asked for EU-only region SLA and written attestations; provided security FAQ deck (drive link).
- 2026-01-15: Procurement asked for network diagram and KMS key ownership model. We provided draft; they flagged backup/redundancy concerns.
- 2026-02-10: Internal budget freeze for Q1 in legal/compliance org; asked to pause active contract work.
- 2026-02-20: Last contact — customer notified that they are moving to DataCloud-EU for an initial pilot because DataCloud committed to Germany-only tenancy.

POC/tech notes:
- Workload: heavy read embeddings for document retrieval (~100 qps) and occasional generation for regulated notices (~10 qps).
- Latency target: p95 < 120ms for retrieval pipeline.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high; prefer reserved capacity if residency satisfied.
- Preferred models: open-source, quantized variants ok if hosted in-EU.

Why stalled/closed-lost:
- Primary blocker: strict data residency (must not leave EU/Germany). Redwood could offer Private, but customer required provider-managed EU-only region on contract with contractual residency SLA and local region isolation; Redwood did not commit to Germany-specific tenancy within procurement timeframe.
- Secondary: procurement budget freeze slowed decision window; lack of an internal champion after compliance lead changed roles.
- Competitor motion: DataCloud-EU offered Germany-only tenancy and signed DPA with local certs; committed to a pilot in Feb.

Next steps (internal):
- Mark as closed-lost for this quarter; move to watchlist for EU-region availability.
- Add to product ask list: Germany-only tenancy + contractual residency SLA.
- Follow-up cadence: quarterly check-ins with Markus; re-open if roadmap confirms region and KMS ownership model that meets legal.
